about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure games — a genre that combines story-driven exploration with keen-eyed observation and clever thinking. In this point-and-click mystery, you’ll search richly detailed scenes for cleverly concealed objects and solve a wide variety of puzzles and brain teasers along the way. It’s like stepping into an interactive mystery novel — you’re not just reading the story, you’re living it!

When the Young Detective Club visits a prestigious art gallery for the unveiling of the long-lost Renaissance painting “The Knights’ Oath,” they expect culture — not danger. But sharp-eyed George spots something off: the brushwork, the canvas, the whole painting feels… fake. With his friends Thomas and Emily, he sets out to uncover the truth. What begins as a simple forgery investigation quickly spirals into a web of secrets, puzzles, and clues hidden for centuries. The painting may be fake — but the danger is all too real.

Immerse yourself in a thrilling mix of classic hidden object scenes and inventive mini-games. Each location is a beautifully crafted challenge designed to test your attention to detail and puzzle-solving smarts!

This Collector's Edition includes:

🕵🏻‍♂️ Test your detective instincts with mysteries adults can’t crack

🕵🏻‍♂️ Discover curious collectibles and hidden lore throughout the game

🕵🏻‍♂️ Solve dozens of unique puzzles and relaxing mini-games

🕵🏻‍♂️ Hunt through an abundance of hidden object scenes

🕵🏻‍♂️ Unlock achievements that reveal key pieces of the story

🕵🏻‍♂️ Explore chilling and atmospheric locations, each rich in secrets

🕵🏻‍♂️ Enjoy beautifully illustrated scenes packed with interactive surprises

Think you’ve got what it takes to see what others miss? Join the Young Detective Club and dive into a shadowy mystery full of suspense, secrets, and surprises. The truth is waiting — hidden in plain sight!
